dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BXT_SolarSmall_Description", "A small free-standing radixite solar panel.")

dt_row.Name: BXT_SolarLarge
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BXT_SolarLarge_Description", "A radixite solar trailer parked beside the Gamma Facility. Provides <Text_Accent>+10 energy</>.")

dt_row.Name: BXT_GerFLakBunker
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BXT_GerFLakBunker_Description", "A concrete bunker with a 3.7 cm and an 8.8 cm Flak, able to switch to <Text_Weapon>shrapnel rounds</>. <Text_Accent>Very tough</>: 2.5x heavy bunker health.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_Ger37MMCaptureBunker
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_Ger37MMCaptureBunker_Description", "A concrete bunker with a 3.7 cm Flak 36 firing <Text_Weapon>6-round clips</>. Once captured it <Text_Accent>fights for you</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerTurretCaptureBunker
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerTurretCaptureBunker_Description", "A concrete bunker with a Jaguar turret and its <Text_Weapon>35mm autocannon</> on 5-round clips. Once captured it <Text_Accent>fights for you</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerMarderStugFactory
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerMarderStugFactory_Description", "A walled assembly hall for Marder and StuG tank destroyers, with <Text_Accent>7000 HP</> of reinforced walls.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerPak40Pit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerPak40Pit_Description", "A 7.5 cm Pak 40 in a low sandbag ring; gun and crew turn a full circle. Fires <Text_Weapon>APCR</> every 5.9 s. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerLeFH18Pit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerLeFH18Pit_Description", "A 10.5 cm leFH 18 in a high sandbag ring with a four-man crew. Fires <Text_Weapon>105mm HE</> every 8 s. <Text_Accent>Long-range fire</> on infantry and positions.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerSFH18Pit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerSFH18Pit_Description", "A 15 cm sFH 18 in a high sandbag ring with a four-man crew. Fires <Text_Weapon>150mm HE</> every 14.4 s and <Text_Accent>outranges the leFH 18 by 20%</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerFlak37Pit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerFlak37Pit_Description", "A 3.7 cm Flak 37 in a sandbag ring; a loader\'s mate passes up <Text_Weapon>6-round clips</> (4.5 s change). <Text_Accent>Good against aircraft and light vehicles</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerFlak88Pit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerFlak88Pit_Description", "An 8.8 cm Flak behind high sandbag walls with a three-man drill. Fires <Text_Weapon>APHE, APCR and HE</> every 5 s. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks at long range</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerMortarPit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerMortarPit_Description", "An 8 cm mortar and its two-man crew in a square sandbag pit. Lobs <Text_Weapon>80mm HE</> over cover every 10 s. <Text_Accent>Good against infantry in cover</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerPuppchenPit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerPuppchenPit_Description", "A Raketenwerfer 43 \'Puppchen\' in a small bag ring. Fires <Text_Weapon>88mm HEAT rockets</> every 6 s, further than a Panzerschreck. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerPanzerschreckPit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerPanzerschreckPit_Description", "A Panzerschreck team in a foxhole behind a ring of bags, firing <Text_Weapon>88mm HEAT rockets</> every 8 s. <Text_Accent>The cheapest anti-tank defence</>, but fragile.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerRailPakBunker
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerRailPakBunker_Description", "A concrete pillbox with a rail-fitted Pak 40 on its roof, firing <Text_Weapon>50mm rail slugs</> that punch through targets. <Text_Accent>Twice as tough as a Pak 40 pit</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerTwinMG42Pit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerTwinMG42Pit_Description", "Two MG 42 nests joined by an ammunition corridor, each with a gunner and a loader. <Text_Weapon>100-round belts</>, 6 s reload. <Text_Accent>Strong against infantry</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerCapturedB4Pit
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerCapturedB4Pit_Description", "A captured Soviet <Text_Weapon>B-4 203mm howitzer</> on a turntable; its crew crane-loads every shell (12 s). <Text_Accent>Longest range of any gun pit</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerHQLaser
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerHQLaser_Description", "The Panzer V/III turret on an HQ platform, firing its <Text_Weapon>Strahlkanone 39</> beam. The height gives it <Text_Accent>double range</> (+100%). Draws <Text_Accent>15 energy</>.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerFlak88Bunker
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerFlak88Bunker_Description", "The Flak 88 pit\'s <Text_Weapon>8.8 cm Flak</> and crew in a concrete Flakstand. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks at long range</>, with twice a heavy bunker\'s health.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerFlakvierlingBunker
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerFlakvierlingBunker_Description", "A <Text_Weapon>2 cm Flakvierling</> in an open concrete emplacement: four rapid-firing barrels. <Text_Accent>1.6x</> a heavy bunker\'s health.")

dt_row.Name: BTX_GerPZ38TBunker
dt_row.Description: NSLOCTEXT("DT_Items [46946556BC7EA84DA27BC2EAA16C45C3]", "BTX_GerPZ38TBunker_Description", "A Pz 38(t) turret with its <Text_Weapon>3.7 cm KwK 38(t)</> on a round concrete pillbox. Cheap anti-tank cover with <Text_Accent>1.5x</> a heavy bunker\'s health.")
